task_flow.notice: Reviewed code-defined test plan, not an execution trace. Arrows do not prove requests, identity propagation, span linkage, or successful authorization. Badges summarize only the explicitly linked recorded checks; missing checks remain NOT RECORDED.
notes: Unapproved returned data remains an enforcement FAIL even when the evaluation task ran correctly.
The authenticated boundary is the Foundry proxy; downstream Learn is public.
